channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Billy Donovan | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Billy Donovan from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mitch Johnson on Billy Donovan
item.description:
Spurs coach Mitch Johnson smiled when a reporter asked him this week about the addition of Billy Donovan to his staff.

“I don't want to be naive enough to think that I'm going to be able to tell you what a 61-year-old Hall of Fame coach like Billy Donovan and his resume can bring to the table,”

Mitch Johnson on Billy Donovan, Oct 2, 2026. Source: San Antonio Express-News.

item.title: Mitch Johnson on Billy Donovan
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Mitch Johnson on #Spurs adding Billy Donovan:

“He's a tremendous person, great personality, fits in seamlessly. He's got worlds of experience and he's an extremely hard worker. He's not kicking his feet up and telling stories. He's rolling his sleeves up and getting his hands dirty.”

Mitch Johnson on Billy Donovan, Oct 1, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Michael Reinsdorf on Billy Donovan
item.description:
Reinsdorf:

“If I interview someone and they're not sold on Billy (Donovan), they're not sold on a Hall of Fame coach, they're not sold on a person who's won championship in college, who's gone deep in the playoffs with Oklahoma City, who I believe, with the Chicago Bulls, every year, given the team that he was given, I think he achieved really good results. Not the results we wanted, but that's not because of Billy. So if someone's not interested in Billy as our coach and if Billy wants to be our coach, and someone's not interested in that, then they're probably not the right candidate for us.”

Michael Reinsdorf on Billy Donovan, Apr 7, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tre Jones on Arturas Karnisovas, Billy Donovan
item.description:
K.C. Johnson:Tre Jones on Artūras Karnišovas and Billy Donovan calling him a pure PG:

“That’s something I take a lot of pride in. I try to organize the offense and use my voice to be a leader. So it’s something I appreciate when people point that out.”

Tre Jones on Arturas Karnisovas, Billy Donovan, Feb 7, 2025. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Billy Donovan
item.description:
Bradley Beal:

“Nobody knows this, I’ve only told a handful of people this. I committed to Florida my sophomore year. The only people that knew were me and Billy Donovan. My parents didn’t know, my brothers didn’t know, my friends didn’t know, my high school coach didn’t know, my AAU coaches didn’t know. Only me and Billy Donovan. They had just come off two championships. He said, 'I’m not guaranteeing you’ll start. I’m not guaranteeing you play time, but you’ll come here, work hard every day to get better, and become a man by the time you leave.' That’s very important versus other coaches who’ll give you this, that, or even offer a house for your parents. I loved that. I’m going to play for him.”

Bradley Beal on Billy Donovan, Oct 8, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Zach LaVine on Billy Donovan
item.description:
LaVine sat the final 10 minutes of the first half with three fouls.

“I asked (Donovan) and he said it was about the foul trouble. He didn’t want me to get my fourth,”

Zach LaVine on Billy Donovan, Oct 26, 2023. Source: NBC Sports Chicago.

item.title: Derrick Jones Jr on Billy Donovan
item.description:
after being asked if he plans to pick up his $3.3 million player option to return to the Chicago Bulls in 2023-24.

“Like I told Coach (Billy Donovan) and everybody else, I’m locked in for two years. I didn’t sign for two years for no reason. So I’m here for two years,”

Derrick Jones Jr on Billy Donovan, Apr 18, 2023. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Nikola Vucevic on Arturas Karnisovas, Billy Donovan
item.description:
“Honestly,I didn’t pay attention to it much. By speaking to AK [executive vice president of basketball operations Arturas Karnisovas] here and [Coach] Billy Donovan, I knew their plan and what they were thinking. “People asked me about it all the time and it was on my Twitter all the time. So when Gobert got traded to Minnesota I thought it would be a good time to have a little joke.”

Nikola Vucevic on Arturas Karnisovas, Billy Donovan, Sep 28, 2022. Source: Chicago Sun-Times.

item.title: Lonzo Ball on Billy Donovan
item.description:
Rob Schaefer:Lonzo Ball on Bulls' front office/Billy Donovan:

“I was impressed. All great guys. The main thing for them is they just want to win and they want guys to get better every day. I can appreciate that. Coming into work every day, knowing that we’re working towards something.”

Lonzo Ball on Billy Donovan, Aug 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @rob_schaef.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Billy Donovan
item.description:
For Bradley Beal, his one-season career at Florida was more than just a stepping stone to the NBA; it was a learning experience that aided his transition into becoming a man, on and off the court.

“It was amazing for me and very well needed. I always say it was short-lived because I love Billy Donovan,and I wanted to win him a national championship, and I always told him that even when he [is] coaching with the Bulls now,”

Bradley Beal on Billy Donovan, Jul 12, 2021. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Steve Clifford on Billy Donovan
item.description:
“I think it'll be a great place for him. He's very upbeat, very excited about his teammates ... loves Billy (Donovan) ...”

Steve Clifford on Billy Donovan, Apr 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @JoshuaBRobbins.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Billy Donovan, Zach LaVine, Coby White
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Doc Rivers on the Chicago Bulls:

“Zach LaVine has been special all year. Coby White is going to be a good player. You can see some of Billy Donovan’s stuff, a lot of good movement. I think he’s been really good for LaVine because of the movement he runs. They’re going to be ok.”

Doc Rivers on Billy Donovan, Zach LaVine, Coby White, Feb 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Lauri Markkanen on Billy Donovan
item.description:
Lauri Markkanen on his comfort level in Billy Donovan's (offensive) system:

“I feel like it’s night and day from last year. Being in down-screens and being on the move the whole time... I’m really liking the offense so far.”

Lauri Markkanen on Billy Donovan, Dec 19, 2020. Source: Twitter @rob_schaef.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Billy Donovan
item.description:
“What was tough for me, what drew me to Florida was my relationship with Billy Donovan,”

Bradley Beal on Billy Donovan, Nov 2, 2020. Source: 247Sports.

item.title: Marc Eversley on Billy Donovan
item.description:
“We were pretty far along in the process. I don't know if we put a number (of eventual interviews on) it, but we had identified a group of candidates who we felt pretty comfortable with going forward if a Billy Donovan were not to become available.”

Marc Eversley on Billy Donovan, Oct 1, 2020. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Joakim Noah on Billy Donovan
item.description:
Joakim Noah:

“Coach Donovan is somebody who is going to hold his players accountable and is somebody who can relate to his players while keeping a relationship with the guys. That’s a tough balance. But he’s proven he’s been able to do it time and time again.”

Joakim Noah on Billy Donovan, Sep 22, 2020. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Brad Stevens, Billy Donovan, Taylor Jenkings
item.description:
“'Billy the Kid' (Billy Donovan) in OKC -- with a team that didn't necessarily have high expectations -- has done a great job. Taylor Jenkins has done a great job in Memphis. But why don't I give it to my former Indiana buddy Brad Stevens for doing a great job losing Kyrie Irving and a few others? Al Horford changing the whole identity of their team and having a great season. I would probably vote for Brad.”

Frank Vogel on Brad Stevens, Billy Donovan, Taylor Jenkings, Jul 18, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Sam Presti on Billy Donovan
item.description:
Erik Horne:Presti on Billy Donovan’s future:

“He’s done an excellent job all five years. Once we get some clarity (on season), we’ll sit down and have those conversations.”

Sam Presti on Billy Donovan, Apr 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @ErikHorneOK.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Billy Donovan
item.description:
Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Billy Donovan:

“He seems like a really honest and straightforward coach, and guys like that I love playing for.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Billy Donovan, Aug 22, 2019. Source: Twitter @maddie_m_lee.

item.title: Sam Presti on Billy Donovan
item.description:
Maddie Lee:Sam Presti on Billy Donovan's ability to develop players:

“I do thing players have come along under his watch. I think Terrance is a good example of that. I think Jerami is a good example of that.”

Sam Presti on Billy Donovan, Jul 25, 2019. Source: Twitter @maddie_m_lee.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Billy Donovan
item.description:
Royce Young:Russell Westbrook on his relationship with Billy Donovan:

“It's been good. Me personally, I've never had a problem with Coach Donovan.”

Russell Westbrook on Billy Donovan, Apr 25, 2019. Source: Twitter @royceyoung.

item.title: Paul George on Billy Donovan, Andre Roberson, Steven Adams
item.description:
“But being around Sam, being around Russ, being around [coach] Billy [Donovan], Dre [Andre Roberson], Steven [Adams], I gained a brotherhood. [Giving that group only] one year just didn’t sit well with me. I went to war, I went to battle, we made the playoffs, we were in the hunt, and we stuck together all year long. You never heard of any turmoil, no matter how we played, in the locker room. We built a real brotherhood there and I didn’t want to walk away from that.”

Paul George on Billy Donovan, Andre Roberson, Steven Adams, Jul 26, 2018. Source: Oklahoman.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Billy Donovan
item.description:
Westbrook on Billy Donovan:

“He’s great, man. Billy did an amazing job. My relationship with him has gotten better and better…He’s done a good job of playing the cards that he’s been dealt and giving us a chance to win.”

Russell Westbrook on Billy Donovan, Apr 28, 2018. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Al Horford on Joakim Noah, Billy Donovan
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Horford on pushing the ball in transition:

“At Florida coach Donovan would let us do that. Joakim and I would break the press – he always gave us that freedom. In high school my coach hated it. He was one of those old school coaches. No big should handle the ball.”

Al Horford on Joakim Noah, Billy Donovan, Dec 2, 2017. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Billy Donovan
item.description:
“(Donovan) just saw how the game was going at the time that I was supposed to come back in and we was already down 20-something points,”

Carmelo Anthony on Billy Donovan, Nov 26, 2017. Source: Oklahoman.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Billy Donovan
item.description:
Fred Katz:Westbrook on Donovan’s lineup changes against the Warriors:

“I always trust anything that Billy does. He’s an exceptional coach and always makes the right decisions.”

Russell Westbrook on Billy Donovan, Nov 24, 2017. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Paul George on Billy Donovan
item.description:
Paul George:

“We have a young group, a lot of talent here, an unbelievable coach (in Billy Donovan), (and) as you see, a front office that's willing to do whatever it takes to improve the team. It just has all the makeups to be a great organization and a chance to put championships together.”

Paul George on Billy Donovan, Sep 24, 2017. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Billy Donovan
item.description:
Fred Katz:Carlisle, who never tells starters pregame, is asked about starters:

“Were gonna start 6 guys.. I asked Donovan. Gonna start w/ double techs”

Rick Carlisle on Billy Donovan, Mar 5, 2017. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Billy Donovan
item.description:
Fred Katz:Durant on Donovan:

“He did a great job for us, man. He really deserved a lot of credit for where we were.”

Kevin Durant on Billy Donovan, Jun 1, 2016. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Billy Donovan
item.description:
Kevin Durant:Kevin Durant on Billy Donovan:

“He was calm all night and that kind of rubbed off on us.”

Kevin Durant on Billy Donovan, Oct 29, 2015. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.
